declared_not_run.name: A4_WAIT375
declared_not_run.why: schedule_coefficient only changes expected wait for effective headways above random_arrival_threshold_min (12); there is no headway-variance term (pathset.py _wait; weights.reliability 0.0 unused). A headway-variance penalty mainly inflates random-arrival wait on frequent service, which this coefficient cannot touch.
